title: Add opum-web to the fleet operating block and refresh lore-web's row
summary: opum-agent (orchestrator) ruling OPAG-69: the fleet is now nine repositories. opum-ai/opum-web exists, dev is its default branch, and it enforces the operating-block digest check -- all gates the orchestrator checked before directing this. Two edits to the fleet operating block table in this repo's CLAUDE.md: lore-web's row now reads 'loregraph.dev -- Lore's public site and hosted-beta waitlist (no working onboarding app)' in place of its retired private-beta-onboarding-app claim, and a new row for opum-web ('opum.ai -- Opum's public umbrella and commercial site') is inserted immediately after quest-web. opum-marketplace's own row is unchanged. EXPECTED_DIGEST in ci.yml moves in the same PR, as directed: 5e543eb84584c382 -> 4cbdcba163ba318f (175 -> 176 lines), verified byte-for-byte against the orchestrator's stated target before committing.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Both row edits land exactly as specified, copied from the operating-block text rather than retyped, since em dashes are load-bearing for the byte-identical digest check.
The resulting operating-block digest equals 4cbdcba163ba318f at 176 lines exactly -- verified before committing, not adjusted to reach it.
The CLAUDE.md edit and the EXPECTED_DIGEST bump land in the same PR, so this repo's own CI is never left failing the digest check in between.

Confirm whether this change trips check . manifests' content-changed guard (it touches CLAUDE.md and ci.yml, not skills/hooks/agents/commands/plugin.json) rather than assuming it does not, and take the Unreleased-CHANGELOG-entry route if it does.

implementationNotes: Bundled two small, directly-related wording fixes into the same commit rather than filing separately: the operating-block digest job's own comments and error message said 'eight repos' / 'eight CLAUDE.md files' / 'eight CI workflows' -- now nine. Left CLAUDE.md's own repository-profile line ('opum-marketplace joins the fleet operating block as the eighth repository') untouched -- that is a dated historical fact about when this repo itself joined, not a live fleet-size count, per this file's own Retirement scope guidance (leave history alone).

No CHANGELOG.md entry: confirmed locally with the same diff scope check . manifests uses (skills/hooks/agents/commands/plugin.json) that this change touches none of them, so the content-changed guard does not fire.
opum-marketplace has no main branch (by decision, recorded in this file's own profile): lands on dev, no promotion to follow.

Digest verified byte-for-byte before committing: awk-extracted block | sha256sum | cut -c1-16 = 4cbdcba163ba318f at 176 lines, matching opum-agent's stated target exactly -- no text adjustment was needed to reach it. Confirmed check . manifests would not fire: `git diff --name-only origin/dev HEAD -- skills/ hooks/ agents/ commands/ .claude-plugin/plugin.json` is empty for this change, so no CHANGELOG entry required.
finalSummary: Landed as 9dd8cac (squash of PR #40). Operating block digest on dev confirmed 4cbdcba163ba318f, matching opum-agent's OPAG-69 target exactly. lore-web and opum-web rows both updated; opum-marketplace's own row unchanged. check . manifests did not fire (confirmed, not assumed); no CHANGELOG entry needed. No promotion to follow -- no main branch in this repo.
